gates.name: EXACT_REFERENCE_PROVENANCE
gates.requirement: Pin F-VQ15/F-MQ23 source-bound admitted reference candidate and exact start head.

gates.name: REFERENCE_IMMUTABILITY
gates.requirement: F-PE01 changes no src production physics and REFERENCE remains the existing qualified route.

gates.name: EXECUTION_CLASS_FAIL_CLOSED
gates.requirement: BALANCED, THROUGHPUT and FALLBACK are DEFINED_NOT_ADMITTED and requests before admission must fail closed.

gates.name: HARD_MASS
gates.requirement: Mass complete, missing contribution mask zero where accepted, and no performance concession to mass conservation.

gates.name: REPRODUCIBLE_COST_SURFACE
gates.requirement: Source-bound workflow measures real serialized reference counts 1/2/8/17/31/32 and deterministic median/p95/p99/max cost summaries.

gates.name: MEMORY_OWNERSHIP
gates.requirement: Persistent state, immutable parameters, worker scratch, runtime metadata and optional process state are explicitly separated; ABI byte observations are not universalized.

gates.name: SYNTHETIC_SCALE
gates.requirement: 1k/10k/100k scale harness exists without claiming 100k full physical solves or production memory capacity.

gates.name: DIFFICULT_TAIL
gates.requirement: 31 easy plus 1 difficult structure exists; synthetic evidence must remain labeled synthetic and cannot support a physical bounded-cost claim.

gates.name: TRANSACTIONAL_REROUTE
gates.requirement: Any future reroute originates from the correct committed state; rejected trials commit neither state nor mass.

gates.name: NO_INVENTED_THRESHOLDS
gates.requirement: F-PE01 defines no production performance or allowable-deviation threshold without later evidence.

metric_rules.primary: deterministic cost counters and hard mass status
metric_rules.secondary: wall clock when measured on a controlled host

known_preconditions_for_later_fpe_work: Propagate accepted-substep, Jacobian, linear-solve and related diagnostics through the kernel/runtime result surface without physics changes.
Separate numerical solver policy controls from the mixed restricted-reference physical parameter carrier before implementing non-reference execution classes.
Add a qualified real difficult physical column before making bounded-cost claims.
Measure real-physics memory payloads before capacity claims for 100k physical columns.
